products.confirmDelete: Remove this product? It will disappear from the storefront but past orders stay intact.
products.lowBanner: {{n}} product(s) low or out of stock — check the badges below.
products.none: No products yet. Add your first one above.
products.shippingExtraHint: Added to the shipping fee for each unit of this product (for big or heavy items).

orders.noCostRecorded: No cost was recorded for this order.

settingsPage.accentHelp: Used for buttons, highlights and links on your shop. The shop is always dark; only this color changes.
settingsPage.logoHelp: Paste a link to your logo image (a transparent PNG or SVG works best). Until you add one, the shop name is shown as text.
settingsPage.bannerHelp: The big picture at the top of your shop. Add one slide for a still banner, or up to {{max}} for a slideshow that changes by itself. Change the pictures here whenever you like. If you add none, the first product photo is used.
settingsPage.timingNote: Only used when you have 2 or more slides.
settingsPage.saved: Saved. Open your storefront to see the changes.
settingsPage.errHttps: Image links must start with https://
settingsPage.errSave: Could not save. Please try again.
settingsPage.checkoutHelp: Choose which details you ask customers for. Name and phone are always required because you need them to deliver.
settingsPage.shippingHelp: Add the places you deliver to and the price for each. Customers choose their area at checkout. If you add no zones, shipping is free and no area is asked.
settingsPage.errZone: Every zone needs a name and a price.
settingsPage.customHelp: Add your own questions (for example a gift message or a preferred delivery time). They appear at the end of the checkout form, in this order.
settingsPage.optionsLabel: Options (one per line, add the Arabic after |)
settingsPage.errCustom: Every extra field needs a label, and a drop-down list needs at least one option.
settingsPage.alertsHelp: Get a Telegram message the moment an order arrives. It is free and instant, and the whole team can be in one group.
settingsPage.alertsSteps: Add your order bot to your team's Telegram group (or send the bot a message), press “Find my chat” and pick it, then press “Send a test message”. Don't forget to save.
settingsPage.noChats: No chat found yet. Add the bot to your group, write a message there, then try again.
settingsPage.alertTestFail: Could not send. Check the chat ID, and that the bot is in the group.
settingsPage.alertNotConfigured: Alerts aren't switched on for this site yet (the bot key is missing).
settingsPage.phoneCodeHint: Egypt is 20. Local numbers like 010... get this code added in front.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.help: Create discount codes. Customers type a code at checkout and see the discount before they order. You can turn a code off at any time.
promos.badCode: Enter a valid code (2–30 letters, numbers, - or _).
promos.badValue: Enter a valid value (a percentage can't be above 100).
promos.badMin: Enter a valid minimum order (or leave it empty).
promos.badLimit: The usage limit must be at least 1 (or leave it empty).
promos.saveFailed: Could not save the code. Please try again.
